about_the_game:
ABOUT THE DEMO

Try out the Demo for a limited version of the full experience!

The demo includes full multiplayer support - play solo or with up to 4 players, just like in the full game.

All equipment is unlocked, so you can jump right in and get a proper feel for the mechanics. However, storage expansion is locked, meaning you can’t unlock additional warehouse space. Some items will also be restricted, so while you’ll get a solid glimpse of the full gameplay, higher-tier items will remain locked.

Progression is limited - there’s a cap on how many in-game days you can advance, and there’s no save system. Once you exit, you’ll have to start fresh.

ABOUT THE GAME

Storage Guys is a casual multiplayer co-op game where you and your friends take on the role of storage crew.


Your job is to receive items at the input ports, sort and organize them in your warehouse, and ship them out through the correct output ports. Every successful shipment makes you money! Each item is labeled with an output region, so you’ll need to sort and ship them to the matching output ports. But watch out for expiration dates, you need to send items out before they expire!



Manage a wide variety of incoming items, each with its own storage needs. Some require extra care, while others are easier to handle. Use specialized storage rooms called compounds to handle items with specific storing requirements, such as Freezer, Hazard, and UV compounds.



Hire and manage AI workers to assist with item handling, boosting productivity and automating your storage workflow. Manage the power room and ensure you have enough fuel for the engines to keep your storage running.


Access the Shop through the Storage Terminal to purchase Shelves, Compounds, Equipment, and Decorations for your storage. Customize your storage to enhance functionality and improve its look.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 - 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon R9 390
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 - 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 480
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Team up with friends and run your own storage! Receive, store and ship items to make a profit. Handle everything from boxes to hazardous goods. Design and expand your warehouse, manage costs, power and workers. Try out the Demo for a limited version of the full experience!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese
